# Locations & Battles

## Alder River {#alder-river}

Alder River is a location on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) with a train station house and a modest hotel, situated eight miles from the [Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) farm across a road lined with farmsteads, fir forests, and apple orchards.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) travels to the Alder River station expecting to collect a boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), only to find an unexpected orphan girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to explain the mistake, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) takes her into his buggy for the drive home, pleasantly surprised to find her chatty company quite enjoyable.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)_

## Aspen Path {#aspen-path}

Named by Isolde, the Aspen Path is a narrow, scenic track running through Mr. Bell's woods that forms part of a romantic route to the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school taken by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +17 more_

> Following the excitement of the school concert, routine resumes at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde discuss turning thirteen and working on school essays along the Aspen Path. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares a dramatic story she wrote for Miss Thorne's assignment, inspiring the creation of a private story club with Isolde and other girls. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discusses the club's creative endeavors with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) dismisses the story writing as foolish and harmful to her studies.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P22](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0022)_

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of roadway near [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge) that is completely covered by an arch of massive apple trees planted by an elderly farmer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +14 more_

## Avery {#avery}

Avery is a scholarship, funded by a wealthy [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick) manufacturer, that provides two hundred and fifty dollars annually for four years of study at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) to the Regent’s graduate scoring highest in English and English Literature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P21](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P22](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P23](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0023), +39 more_

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the town residence of Isolde's [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), featuring a library where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stayed during her week of entrance exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P5](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P6](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P8](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0008), +11 more_

**Associated with:** [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md)

> Isolde informs [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) of an invitation from [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) to visit her in town for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) consents, Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) drives the girls to Beechwood, Aunt Lavinia's home, where [Miss Pembroke](../character/miss-pembroke.md) welcomes them warmly. The girls spend the week taking in the town's attractions, including attending the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and a concert.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Nell’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a large, noisy city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked during a winter, meeting [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Murray in a shop, and to which he returned after her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md)

## Boulters {#boulters}

The Boulters are a family whose members, including Levi, are characterized by a heavily marked stubborn trait.

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P53](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0053), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P54](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0054), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P56](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0056), +5 more_

## Brendan’s Island {#brendan-s-island}

St. Brendan’s Island, also referred to as the Island, is a region near [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where custom dictates that travelers bow to everyone they pass along the road.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P22](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), +15 more_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is day-dreaming while studying when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) angrily confronts her about her cow escaping into his oat field again. After he leaves in a huff, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) locks the cow away and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby over tea.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P1](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0001), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde begin canvassing for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), first visiting the Andrew sisters. While [Eliza](../character/eliza-pullen.md) bitterly refuses to donate, Catherine sneaks out to give them two quarters for the hall fund before they visit Daniel Blair.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## Brierley {#brierley}

Brierley is a rural home settlement featuring a local school, beech-woods, hollows filled with violets, and a branch train line connects to nearby [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P5](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P6](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P8](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0008), +35 more_

**Associated with:** [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Thorne](../character/thorne.md)

> At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts a dare from [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole. She slips and falls, breaking her ankle in the process. Mr. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) carries her home to [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends the next seven weeks recovering in bed while friends, neighbors, and local figures visit her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to Brierley school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

After visiting Obed's grave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) on the hill and thanks him for stepping aside for the school position, leading the two former foes to reconcile and become friends. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and later reflects contentedly at her window on her future path.

> In a letter to [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts amusing experiences and humorous remarks from her students while teaching school in Brierley. She shares duplicates of student compositions, including an unexpectedly romantic letter from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) that was copied from old love letters, before introducing a letter from her favorite student, [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is the legendary setting of Tennyson's poem featuring King Arthur, Guinevere, Lancelot, and [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), which [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply romanticized and wished had been her place of birth.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P5](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), +14 more_

## Canadian {#canadian}

Canadian denotes a nation or nationality governed by a Premier, whose capital is located at Ottawa.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## Crystal Lake {#crystal-lake}

Crystal Lake is a marshy spot named by chance from a set of proposed titles written on birch bark and drawn from Nell's hat.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P23](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0023), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P24](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0024), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P25](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0025), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P26](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0026), +7 more_

## Delford {#delford}

Delford is a nearby settlement with a school and shopping facilities, connected by road to [Stonebridge](../codex/places.md#stonebridge), [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel), and [Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P53](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0053), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P56](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0056), +18 more_

**Associated with:** [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Shearer](../character/shearer.md)

## East Welby {#east-welby}

East Welby is a place where [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visited an exceedingly sick, far-off relation named Mary, whose local neighbors she was never on particularly good terms with.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

**Associated with:** [Baxter](../character/baxter.md)

## Echo Cottage {#echo-cottage}

Echo Cottage is a beloved stone residence with a garden and honeysuckle trellis where Miss Rosalind resides, and which is intended to be kept intact for summer visits following her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover Echo Cottage, where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Rosalind welcomes Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at Echo Cottage and explains her solitary life, imaginative habits, and why her young helper is called Belinda the Fourth. When [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's name is mentioned, Miss Rosalind asks if he is [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's son before growing quiet and distant. As the girls walk away, they reflect on her loneliness and the meaning of names.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks to Echo Cottage to spend a cozy winter night with Miss Rosalind, who shares the story of her long-ago engagement to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and the prideful misunderstanding that separated them. A month later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) brings Stephen's son, [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), to meet Miss Rosalind, and the two quickly bond during a pleasant visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXIII Miss Rosalind’s Romance P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

> While picking strawberries for tea, [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) expresses concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's lingering melancholic mood and failing health. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resolves to stay at Echo Cottage during her vacation to help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits. Afterwards, the group enjoys tea outside, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) sits with Miss Rosalind as she opens up to him about her imaginary dream-boy.

> Isolde leaves Grey Shutters unwell, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After learning Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) blames [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for getting Isolde drunk, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to clear up the mistake but is rebuffed. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then confronts Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) coldly turns her away.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) wakes up at Grey Shutters and marvels at the bright June morning outside her window, though she laments that her stay will likely be brief. During breakfast and while helping with household chores, she talks incessantly to a sharp yet increasingly fascinated [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), even bestowing names like [Frost Maiden](../codex/places.md#frost-maiden) on the cherry tree and Bonny on the geranium. Afterwards, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) takes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in the buggy to [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Tranter](../character/tranter.md) and settle Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), despite Obed's quiet desire to keep the girl.

Enraged by the insult, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) flies into a violent temper and shouts at Mrs. Sowerby before storming off to her room. After Mrs. Sowerby leaves in offense, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) goes upstairs to lecture [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and demands that she apologize, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses.

The two young girls quickly bond and swear to be best friends forever before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home. Back at Grey Shutters, [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) gives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chocolates, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) admits to him that she is growing fond of the girl.

Port Marlow is a location on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) where travelers can board a train.

## Primrose Dell {#primrose-dell}

Primrose Dell is a small, green hollow located past [Reedmere](../codex/places.md#reedmere) and shaded by Mr. Andrew Bell's large forest, which was named by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and blossoms with millions of violets in the springtime.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Reedmere {#reedmere}

Reedmere is a location situated along the scenic route taken by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde on their way to school, located between Mr. Pembroke's back field and [Primrose Dell](../codex/places.md#primrose-dell).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Regent’s Academy {#regent-s-academy}

Regent’s Academy is an educational institution located in [Port Marlow](../codex/places.md#port-marlow) where students can take classes toward teacher's licenses, complete studies in subjects such as domestic science and English literature, and compete for medals and college scholarships.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Regent’s Girl P8](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. **Associated with:** Carrow, [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md)

## Rhine {#rhine}

The Rhine is a river that features in the title of a poem, "Bingen on the Rhine," which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) memorized from her school readings.

## Rome {#rome}

Rome is a place whose construction was not accomplished in a single day.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P9](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0009), +5 more_

## Sabbath {#sabbath}

According to a hymn mentioned by [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), the Sabbath day is described as being uninterrupted.

## Sowerby’s Hollow {#sowerby-s-hollow}

Sowerby’s Hollow is a hollow located where the main road in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) slopes into a small ravine crossed by a calm rivulet, and it is the site of Mrs. Agatha Sowerby's home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. > Mrs. Agatha Sowerby notices [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) dressed up and leaving town in a buggy on a busy afternoon, sparking her curiosity. Later that evening, she visits [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to discover the reason for his trip. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) explains that [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) has gone to the train station to pick up an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on their farm, leading [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to express her strong doubts and warnings.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Toronto {#toronto}

Toronto is a place where the author Mrs. Charlotte E. Varley resides.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), +5 more_

## Tory Road {#tory-road}

Tory Road is a secluded, grassy, and lightly traveled thoroughfare in [Tullyvale](../codex/places.md#tullyvale) flanked by young spruces, constructed by the [Tory](../codex/factions.md#conservative) government and home to the Copp sisters and Martin Bovyer.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P13](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0013), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P14](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0014), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), +11 more_

> While waiting in the duckhouse, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes down a garden conversation with Isolde's assistance. Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp frees [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with a hatchet, feeds the girls, and agrees to sell them her willow-ware platter for twenty-five dollars, revealing she plans to get married. The girls then drive away with the platter along Tory Road.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P51](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0051), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P64](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0064)_

## Tullyvale {#tullyvale}

Tullyvale is a settlement located ten miles away, containing homesteads as well as the secluded [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) and Wesley Keyson's place.

## Twin Sailors {#twin-sailors}

The Twin Sailors are imaginary stone companions residing perpetually at sea who frequently land at the Striped Rocks to converse with [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md).

West Welby is a locale accessible by a road that runs near the Kimball family's place and through surrounding woods.
